title: Kaliningrad
description: Kaliningrad Oblast is the only part of Russia whose coverage is entirely autumn, and it is entirely long antenna. Trees are lined along the road, often with a ring of white paint around the trunk, the verge grass is long, the architecture looks European, and the car's brake light is redder than usual.

title: Pskov sample
description: Quite thin roads over red-brown soil, generally Baltic-looking with flowers and shrubbery, usually overcast or freshly rained on.

title: M-11 motorway
description: A massive divided highway, in practice the only Russian road with double guardrails and infrastructure of that standard, carrying an outer yellow line. No car in the Novgorod half, black car in the Tver half, though it is hard to see on this road.

title: St. Petersburg
description: A wealthy historic downtown, street signs found nowhere else in the country, and pedestrian signs specific to the city and Leningrad Oblast. A lot of the coverage is summer Generation 4.

title: North Murmansk
description: Hilly to very hilly ground under low foliage, with northern pink flowers, rocks lying on the verge or showing through the soil, and sometimes a yellow middle line.

title: Murmansk south-east road
description: No car September Generation 4 along a sandy verge, red soil on the eastern part of the road, northern pink flowers, rocks on the verge or in the soil, and often moss beside the road.

title: Karelia
description: Black car with a long antenna in early June, a sandy verge, and rocks lying on the roadside or showing through the soil.

title: Moscow
description: A wealthy historic downtown with street signs found nowhere else in the country, and a lot of late spring and summer Generation 4. Moscow buildings can often be told from those of St. Petersburg on look alone: the latter appear more historic and more decorative.

title: Vladimir May coverage
description: Early May black car with a long antenna, recognisable by very yellow leaves and a few trees with none at all — there is no earlier coverage in Generation 3. The season is rare: in order of frequency southern Vladimir Oblast, southern Sakhalin Oblast, south-east Leningrad Oblast, Borovichi in Novgorod Oblast, and very rarely April 2013 in Moscow Oblast near Dubna.

title: Penza red car and fog
description: Red car winter Generation 4 over sandyish roadside soil. The coverage sometimes turns quite foggy or hazy.

title: Kamyshin
description: No car May Generation 4 across reasonably flat ground with low shrubbery and red soil, usually under an overcast sky.

title: Kalmykia
description: Very flat and dry, with a short antenna. A smudge on the lens in this climate can only be Kalmykia or Astrakhan.

title: Astrakhan long antenna
description: Black car with a long antenna over very flat, dry ground: red soil carrying sporadic grass.

title: Astrakhan Generation 4
description: No car winter Generation 4, very dry with dark brown soil, usually flat and with low foliage.

title: Krasnodar sample
description: Southern Krasnodar turns very mountainous and lush, usually with a black car and a long antenna. In the south the long antenna is limited to, in order of frequency, Krasnodar, Stavropol, Adygea and Cherkessia.

title: Arkhyz road
description: Southern Cherkessia turns very mountainous. A short blurred antenna together with mountains of this kind is almost always Cherkessia.

title: Kabardino-Balkaria
description: No car winter Generation 4 beneath very distinctively shaped mountains that look dry in this coverage. The south gets snow, and these road barriers are common here.

title: Tarskoe
description: No car winter Generation 4, and about as close to mountains of this size as the coverage gets without driving into them — found in this area only.

title: Dagestan Generation 4
description: No car winter Generation 4, distinguished from other winter coverage by green grass rather than dead, over soil of an unusual colour. Dry barren landscapes turn up in the north of the republic.

title: Orenburg Generation 4
description: No car May Generation 4 on ground that often turns hilly, with dead-looking bushes along the road.

title: Orenburg autumn
description: Black car with a long antenna in October, over soil of an unusual colour.

title: White car Chelyabinsk
description: White car with a long antenna across an open, semi-dry landscape. Thickly bunched birches can be found here too, as in the rest of the post-Ural region.

title: Kurgan
description: Short antenna of the very B type over somewhat flat ground with bunched birches.

title: Novosibirsk road
description: Red car summer Generation 4 driving east along a busy road, usually with trucks on it. Otherwise it looks like Omsk, but on a main road and with the red car.

title: Tomsk red car
description: Red car summer Generation 4, often on dirt roads with the trees standing close.

title: Tomsk no car sample
description: No car summer Generation 4. Power lines running along the road are quite common in Tomsk.

title: Komi sample
description: No car summer Generation 4 under northern foliage, which often includes this plant. Komi pavement can be very salt-and-peppery.

title: Perm May
description: Short blurred antenna in May, on a wide road with poor to very poor pavement, over hilly ground.

title: Sverdlovsk road
description: Black car with a long blurred antenna in September, driving south-west past very distinctive foliage and scattered tall trees, with small rocks on the verge.

title: Lykhma
description: Black car with a long blurred antenna in August, on blocky pavement.

title: Surgut area
description: Red car summer Generation 4 along a very sandy verge under northern foliage. No car Generation 4 can be found further west in Khanty-Mansi, outside this range.

title: Tazovskii road
description: Red car summer Generation 4 along a very sandy verge under short foliage, typically with a yellow line or blocky pavement.

title: Nadym road
description: Red car summer Generation 4 under short foliage, on a highly distinctive gravelly soil and pavement.

title: Nenets
description: No car summer Generation 4 on blocky pavement, with very little or no tall foliage, under a cloudy sky. The coverage runs into the sunset at its end.

title: Vorkuta
description: Black car with a long antenna over relatively flat, extremely dead-looking ground with reddish soil and some snow. Buildings this far north often stand on large supports because of the permafrost, though that is almost never needed to name the place.

title: Kemerovo May
description: Red car May Generation 4 over hilly ground with dark soil, and a lot of rural coverage.

title: Altai Republic white car
description: White car with a long antenna in October, in the mountains. These guardrails are found there fairly often.

title: Khakassia haze
description: Grassy steppe mountains under hazy coverage, with a short antenna of the very B type.

title: Krasnoyarsk yellow middle line
description: Short antenna of the very B type, a yellow middle line, and hilly ground.

title: Krasnoyarsk city
description: Red car May or June Generation 4, with mountains to the south. The districts look quite different from one another, but the coverage is often either open with wooden housing or downtown among large city buildings.

title: Lesosibirsk road
description: Black car with a long antenna in early June, driving south on a main road. The Krasnoyarsk bus stop can be seen along it.

title: Bratsk sample
description: Black car with a long antenna over very red soil, among eastern trees.

title: Irkutsk main road Generation 4
description: Red car summer Generation 4 driving south through haze.

title: Irkutsk grass-divided highway
description: Highways divided by a strip of grass are common around Irkutsk and Bratsk, though they occur elsewhere too. Black car with a long antenna.

title: Tunkinsky National Park
description: No car summer Generation 4 among very remote, beautiful mountains. Siberian larches become exceedingly common here and further east.

title: Buryatia fog
description: No car summer Generation 4 in the mountains, under very thick fog, with long grass.

title: Eastern Buryatia
description: No car summer Generation 4 over ground that is relatively flat for Buryatia, semi-open with scattered trees and long grass.

title: Irkutsk general landscape
description: Black car with a long blurred antenna over open fields with long grass.

title: Baikal sand dunes
description: A very sandy road through an Irkutsk-type but drier landscape, hilly, with water often in sight. On the island the coverage sits near sunset.

title: Alla mountains
description: Black car with a long blurred antenna, with large and very distinctive mountains close by to the north-west, and long grass.

title: Chita main road
description: Black car with a long blurred antenna driving west through an Irkutsk-type landscape, with the Chita hills around.

title: Primorsky Krai
description: White car with a long antenna in the mountains, very often under cloud.

title: Sakhalin May
description: Black car with a long blurred antenna in May, in the mountains. May is a rare season, and Sakhalin is the only place where it comes with a landscape like this.

title: Sakhalin Okha road
description: Black car with a long blurred antenna on an extremely sandy road. The foliage is somewhat short but still made of Siberian larches.

title: Sakha sample
description: White car summer Generation 4 over quite flat ground with soil of an unusual colour, among Siberian larches.

title: Lensk
description: White car summer Generation 4 under extreme orange forest-fire haze, among Siberian larches. Every road is a dirt road except in downtown Lensk.

title: Kolyma Highway
description: White car summer Generation 4 through the mountains among Siberian larches, over a distinctive black or dark grey soil, darkest around Ust-Nera.

title: Magadan
description: White car summer Generation 4, or black car long antenna tilted left in Generation 3, with mountains all around and the coast often in sight, among Siberian larches. Forest-fire haze here is white rather than orange in Generation 4, and extreme white haze points to the road west of the city.

title: Kamchatka
description: Silver car with a long antenna, the most distinctive soil in Russia, snow-capped volcanoes usually in sight, and Erman's birches.

title: Salt-and-pepper road to Khanymey
description: The road to Khanymey, branching off the road north to Novy Urengoy, has a very recognisable salt-and-pepper (grey-speckled) surface, in a far-northern landscape with very low, sparse vegetation.

title: Boxy balconies of the Caucasus
description: Boxy, closed balconies made of horizontal planks are found in urban areas of south-eastern European Russia, mainly Astrakhan oblast and the North Caucasus republics. Nalchik has a unique variant with metal panels in a frame.

title: Square-tiled Soviet facades (Yekaterinburg/Tyumen)
description: Soviet concrete apartment blocks whose facades are covered in perfectly square blocks are most likely in the Yekaterinburg–Tyumen area. Elsewhere, facades tend to use small rectangular bricks or other patterns.

title: Ornate gates of Dagestan
description: Houses in Dagestan often have richly decorated gates with a large frame and wooden mouldings.

title: Red-banded poles of Mordovia (Saransk)
description: Poles painted white with red bands are very common in Saransk and are found in other towns of Mordovia, but almost nowhere else. Saransk also has unique street signs in Russian, Moksha, Erzya and English.

title: Four-language street signs of Saransk
description: Saransk has uniquely shaped street signs written in four languages (Russian, Moksha, Erzya and English); outside the city centre, signs have three lines.

title: Yaroslavl/Vologda P104
description:
C type short antenna summer coverage
Sunset driving southeast with poor pavement
Extremely sunny with almost no clouds
Rows of trees directly next to road
Sandy side of road with occasional hogweed and fireweed

title: Belgorod
description:
Black car A type and tilted left long antenna fall coverage
Very hilly with dark black soil
Agricultural fields are abundant, especially with sunflowers

title: South-West Vologda
description:
C type short antenna summer coverage
Very sunny
Straight road angles
Unique clearings between the road and the tree lines.

title: Rostov Winter
description:
Red car/No car with antenna gen 4 winter
Very dark soil with some snow
Occasionally will have black car with antenna

title: Novosibirsk Snow
description:
White car A type long antenna fall coverage
Snow everywhere
Generally flat
Foliage consists nearly entirely of birch clusters and rows.
Not to be confused with the Altai Krai white car fall coverage which tends to be hilly and has no snow.

title: Smolensk M1
description:
A type short antenna summer coverage
Dark sandy soil next to road
Will often see fireweed
The only other places that have A type with fireweed are Karelia and Leningrad, however neither have divided roads in A type coverage.

title: Abaza Road
description:
Black car B type long antenna summer coverage
Very hilly with vegetation consisting of various birches, pines and larches
Driving north which helps distinguish from the Tanzybey road
South of Abaza, there is a smudge to the front right of the driving direction

title: Tanzybey Road
description:
Black car B type long antenna summer coverage
Will often see snow capped mountains 
Very similar landscape to the Abaza road in Khakassia, however this one drives south instead of north

title: South of Chita
description:
Black car long antenna summer coverage
Green rolling hills with general Mongolian-Manchurian Steppe landscape
Always driving south/east
South of Khada-Bulak, the weather becomes overcast 
South of Karanor will have rain coverage.

title: Kolpashevo Fog
description:
Gen 4 no car August coverage
In typical Tomsk fashion, there is pole spam
Soil typically is very gravelly
Not to be confused with Buryatia, Sakha or Magadan fog
Buryatia fog areas are mountainous and are barely forested
Sakha has white car and fog can be a pinker color 
Magadan also has white car, is extremely mountainous and has a different soil color

title: Leningrad
description:
Black car A type long antenna
May coverage (some summer)
Northern vibe with slightly red soil, pines and occasional hogweed
Mostly offroads; no major roads

title: Kostroma May
description:
B type short antenna May coverage
The only other places with B type May are Moscow, Vladimir and Sverdlovsk however road quality, soil quality, hilliness and vegetation are usually enough to differentiate
Strange front smudge on northern part of road
Bad road quality that has occasional faded outer lines and no center
Some other Kostroma May roads are unpaved

title: Chelyabinsk M-5
description:
No car with antenna August gen 4
Sometimes antenna will not be visible, but landscape and season should suffice
Looks nearly September
Ural mountains visible in open areas, else heavily forested
Relatively high amount of traffic

title: Bashkortostan May
description:
No car gen 4 May coverage
Signature Bashkortostan red soil
Rolling hills with intermittent random inselberg-esque rock formations

title: Cherkessk
description:
White car B type tilted right long antenna summer coverage
This is basically all you need to know; see this combo of car meta insta send Cherkessk in a real game
Hilly urban coverage
Rocky paths typical of the south

title: Road to Komsomolsk
description:
White car A type long antenna summer coverage
Presence of birches separates this road from Primorsky 
Mountainous with intermittent open fields

title: West Bryansk
description:
Black car blurred long antenna fall coverage
Relatively flat compared to other fall coverage western oblast regions such as Tula, Belgorod, and Lipetsk
Darkish soil accompanied by tall pines
If you find yourself on a flat and straight forest road in fall coverage, you’re probably in Bryansk

title: Tula Megalong
description:
Black car Megalong antenna fall coverage
Most of the landscape consists of rolling hills
Like many of the western oblast regions, has characteristically dark soil, but can be slightly lighter/sandier than that of Oryol or Belgorod
Unfortunately Belgorod, Bryansk and Tula can be hard to differentiate. Even with the antenna, it is no easy task. It usually is much more vibe based than anything that can be concretely detailed.

title: Don River Volgograd
description:
Black car blurred antenna fall coverage
Short and dead looking vegetation
Note lack of birch trees
Distinct rust brown soil

title: Tyumen Spill
description:
No car gen 4 summer coverage
Very sunny, with hardly any clouds in the sky if at all
“Omsk trees” 
“Tyumen grass”
Sometimes Omsk can be sunny as well so be sure to look at other context clues

title: North of Salekhard
description:
Red car gen 4 summer
Unlike the rest of Yamalo-Nenets, this area is decently hilly with the Ural Mountains visible in many panoramas.
Extremely short vegetation
Even urban areas are hilly, distinguishing them from other cities in Yamalo-Nenets

title: West Altai Krai Road
description:
B type short antenna
Back smudge with one side smudge
Sunrise south of Slavgorod
Very flat Siberian landscape 
Abundance of Russian olives
Railroad visible on many parts of the road

title: Perm
description:
No car with antenna gen 4 late summer coverage
Only other city with late summer and antenna is Chelyabinsk, which looks much more like September than August
Reddish-brown soil
Slightly hilly

title: Yaroslavl
description:
Black car B type tilted left antenna May coverage
As is the case with Kostroma, Yaroslavl tends to have terrible road quality
Slightly hilly with brown soil 
The landscape can be characterized as vast open fields with forest stands strewn about with relatively low vegetation
Western Ivanovo also has tilted left May coverage in addition to it having tilted left June. Use other context clues to differentiate between the two

title: Gorno-Altaysk
description:
B type short antenna summer coverage
Front smudge in the city proper
Very mountainous
South road will have Katun river visible to the west at some points
With back smudge and one side smudge, the only other place that will have mountains in B type is Kemerovo where they are not tall nor as close to the road as they are in Altai Republic

title: Kirov R-169
description:
Black car tilted right long antenna summer coverage
Driving north
Absolutely covered in hogweed in the northern parts of the road
Most of the road is lined with tree rows, whereas the south starts to open up
Southern bit of road is sunset

title: Smolensk Blurred
description:
Black car blurred antenna fall coverage
Very sunny with nearly no clouds in the sky
The west road drives north and the east road drives east
To differentiate between the two, the east road has contrails in the sky whereas the west road does not
Sunset coverage for both
Road quality varies from being unpaved to passable
As typical for Smolensk, very sandy sides of the road

title: Altai Krai Gen 4
description:
No car gen 4 summer coverage
Very flat with open agricultural fields
May look like Omsk, but the birches are in rows instead of clusters. In addition, there’s a wider assortment of foliage such as oaks and olive trees.
Very gravelly light brown soil

title: Mari-El
description:
Blurred short antenna summer coverage
Unique angle + driving north
Very sandy side of road
Both sides of road completely covered in pines
May have “Omsk trees” sometimes

title: Murmansk September SW Road
description:
No car gen 4 September coverage
Sandy side of road
Very rocky
Fireweed prevalent 
To differentiate this road from the SE Murmansk September road, this road has no red soil and most coverage on this road is post rain, thus the road appears wet, especially on the western part
